title: Adding and editing songs
text:
Open data/catalogue.csv in Excel or LibreOffice and add a row for each song. Give each song a new id (S007, S008, and so on) and never reuse or change an id.
Put topics in the topics column separated by semicolons, for example Worship; Thanksgiving. Spell topics the same way every time, since each spelling becomes its own topic page.
Save as CSV (UTF-8), then in RStudio run source("R/build_songs.R").

The script creates a page in songs/ for every new song and rebuilds all topic pages. Running it again is always safe: it updates the details at the top of each song page but never touches lyrics you have typed.

title: Adding and editing songs
text:
Open data/catalogue.csv in Excel or LibreOffice and add a row for each song. Give each song a new id (S007, S008, and so on) and never reuse or change an id.
Put topics in the topics column separated by semicolons, for example Worship; Thanksgiving. Spell topics the same way every time, since each spelling becomes its own topic page.
Save as CSV (UTF-8), then in RStudio run source("R/build_songs.R").

The script creates a page in songs/ for every new song and rebuilds all topic pages. Running it again is always safe: it updates the details at the top of each song page but never touches lyrics you have typed.

title: Adding and editing songs
text:
Typing lyrics
Open the song’s file in songs/ and replace the placeholder under ::: {.lyrics}. Start each line with | so line breaks are kept, and leave a blank line between verses:
### Verse 1
| First line of the verse
| Second line of the verse

### Chorus
| First line of the chorus

title: Adding and editing songs
text:
Planning a service
Copy a file in services/, rename it with the service date, and list the songs. Links to songs use their file name, for example ../songs/S001-amazing-grace.qmd.

title: Adding and editing songs
text:
Publishing
Commit and push to GitHub. The site rebuilds itself within a couple of minutes.

title: Amazing Grace
text:
Language: English | Type: Hymn | Key: G | Composer: John Newton | Vestry folder: Folder 1



Verse 1
Amazing grace! how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now am found,
Was blind, but now I see.


Verse 2
’Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,
And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed!
